data.name: Awlan
data.gender_notes: Awlan is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic root 'awlana' meaning 'friend'. In Islamic history, Awlan is the name of a companion of the Prophet Muhammad (pbuh) known for his courage and loyalty. The name Awlan carries the meaning “Friend” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Awlan usually hope their child will grow to embody friend and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A symbol of brotherhood and companionship in the path of Islam.
data.etymology: Awlan belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Friend.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Awlan total 6, giving a life-path number of 6. Number 6 is linked with Venus and with the qualities of responsibility, care and community.

in_english.name: Awlan
in_english.meaning: Awlan is an Islamic name that symbolizes companionship
in_english.long_meaning: Awlan is an Arabic name that symbolizes companionship, derived from the Arabic root "Awl", which connotes good companionship. This name has been in use since the early days of Islam, and its significance is rooted in the Islamic tradition of valuing good company. In Islamic teachings, companionship is considered a desirable trait, and individuals with this name are often seen as having strong social connections and a sense of community. The name Awlan has been popularized in various Muslim cultures, including Arabic, Urdu, and Turkish-speaking communities. Its meaning and significance extend beyond its literal translation, representing a deeper understanding of the importance of companionship in Islam.

data.cultural_impact: The name Awlan holds a significant cultural impact in Islamic history, as it was the name of a renowned Sahabi (companion) of the Prophet Muhammad (pbuh). Awlan ibn Badr Al-Aslami (ra) was a brave warrior from the Ansar (helpers) of Medina who distinguished himself in several battles. His name is mentioned in various Hadiths, and he is celebrated for his steadfastness and commitment to Islam. Due to his association with the Prophet Muhammad (pbuh) and the early Islamic community, the name Awlan continues to evoke a sense of courage, loyalty, and historical significance within the Islamic culture.
data.spiritual_significance: The name Awlan also holds a spiritual significance for Muslims. It serves as a reminder of the importance of having friends who support and encourage one to strive for righteousness and devotion to Allah. The Sahabi Awlan (ra) is a role model for the pious friendship and brotherhood that is encouraged in Islam. The name reflects the essential quality of being a good friend to others, embodying faith, kindness, and loyalty. The spiritual value of the name Awlan lies in its ability to inspire individuals to cultivate meaningful relationships that not only provide companionship and support but also foster spiritual growth and solidarity within the Muslim community.
